measurement_note: Final comparisons use final_baseline and final_protected_candidate, unprofiled five samples each. Other retained runs are diagnostic or exploratory, not discarded. Disposable localhost Postgres only. No production/CDN/HTTP timing claim.

baseline_diagnostic.limits: Fresh object per sample; database/OS caches may be warm. Timers add overhead. Aggregation includes grouping and Decimal work. Row loading includes SQL/transfer/iteration/decoding. Same-object warm call is process cache. Execute includes server execution and libpq transfer; fetch includes driver decoding and Row wrapping; row_wrap is nested inside fetch. Per-row timers add overhead; use uninstrumented benchmarks for latency. No CDN, HTTP, TLS, production or whole-page latency claim.
